open_items.name: k
open_items.description: Number of replicates per task across arms; requires operator budget envelope.

open_items.name: Exact inference implementation
open_items.description: Exact rational aggregation, float64 conversion, ddof=1 sample SD, frozen t-critical table, and dual IUT gate.

open_items.name: simulation model of bounded discrete scores
open_items.description: Frozen SE-1 SimulationModel enforces structural invariant mu_Delta <= mu_A because unguided search gains are non-negative (E[A_u] >= 0). It cannot instantiate the IUT null boundary face N_A (mu_Delta > 0.10, mu_A = 0.00) or N_intersection (mu_Delta = 0.10, mu_A = 0.00). Requires SE-2 model amendment with mechanistic search-to-confirmatory transfer.

open_items.name: adaptive-procedure model
open_items.description: Shared-parent Search state machine with M mutations, strict > acceptance, and out-of-sample Confirmatory evaluation.

open_items.name: a-priori scenario grid and weights
open_items.description: Scenario register in p2_scenarios.json specifying N_delta, N_A, N_intersection (zero and positive covariance), H1 targets, and stress cases without averaging weights.

open_items.name: target power
open_items.description: Evaluated across candidates {0.80, 0.90, 0.95}; final freeze requires operator budget review.

open_items.name: B_max
open_items.description: Maximum affordable even block count; bound set by operator costing envelope.

open_items.name: B
open_items.description: Deterministic rule selecting the smallest even B satisfying simultaneous Clopper-Pearson bounds, or returning underpowered_no_launch.

open_items.name: simulation seeds
open_items.description: Domain-separated PRNG streams keyed deterministically by SHA-256 hash of the controlling plan.

open_items.name: Monte Carlo error tolerance
open_items.description: Family-wise Clopper-Pearson bounds with epsilon = 0.005 for Type I UCB and exact LCB on target power.

open_items.name: schedule generator
open_items.description: Cyclic permutation mapping indexed by (block, task, replicate) guaranteeing exact 50/50 Search balance and near-balance across 6 final permutations.

open_items.name: filling algorithm
open_items.description: Family-grouped canonical length-prefixed SHA-256 sorting filling 12 Admission, 8 Search, 8 Confirmatory, and 6 Secondary tasks.

open_items.name: ceiling values/classifications
open_items.description: Hard preventive vs. post-call accounting boundaries for tokens, calls, and timeouts.

open_items.name: guided/control instructions
open_items.description: Exact UTF-8 prompt byte strings for Guided (with search scores/traces) and Unguided (task-agnostic mutation).

open_items.name: trace bounds
open_items.description: Evaluator trace token sizing, truncation algorithms, and maximum overshoot bounds.

open_items.name: selection/tie-breaking rule
open_items.description: Exact rational strict inequality child_score > parent_score; incumbent parent is strictly retained on ties.

open_items.name: allowed metadata
open_items.description: Field-level JSON schemas for mutation payloads across Guided and Unguided arms.

open_items.name: P15 role quotas, filling order, mutation count and call arithmetic
open_items.description: 12 Admission tasks (4/4/4), M mutations, and total pilot call identity 2 * (60 + 24M)k evaluator runs.

open_items.name: permitted provider-specific zero-byte retry statuses
open_items.description: Evidence-backed classification of safe pre-transmission vs. unsafe ambiguous transport errors.
